item.title: Image Prompts I Have Been Using
item.description: When I started blogging earlier this year, I used GPT-5 to generate images, but the results were still rather plain. Research kept me busy and the blog sat idle for a while. Now Gemini 3 Nano Banana Pro has taken another step forward, and I have a little more time, so I decided to replace the old images and see whether it could handle the job. These are some of the prompts I used; feel free to try them if you like the pictures.
